info.title: IoTFast Thing Model & UNS Data Engine API
info.description: Machine contract (OpenAPI 3.1) for the standalone IoTFast Thing Model & UNS Data Engine (`iotfast_server`), strictly aligned with D00.2 decisions Q01-Q12. Covers Control Plane catalog/asset/binding APIs, Southbound telemetry/state ingestion, Dual-Dimension ingestion status (`GET /v1/ingestions/{ingest_id}`), Northbound resource discovery, Device business view/shadow, History query, and WebSocket subscription frames (`subscription_terminated` vs `resync_required`).

SignedScopeToken.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed service token bound to VerifiedScopeContext (Q02). Client-reported scope headers (X-Tenant-Id, X-Role, etc.) are strictly rejected with 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

type.description: Emitted ONLY when authorization remains valid but pending delta buffer overflowed or snapshot boundary S was violated (Q05, T09, NB06).
Emitted when subscriber session credential expires or scope is revoked (Q05, SC10). Distinct from resync_required.
